blockers.detail: spng_decode_image(ctx, out, out_size, SPNG_FMT_RGBA8, SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS): the decode flag SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA is never passed, so the gAMA-chunk dependent gamma correction (lookup table construction and per-pixel application, guarded by flags & SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA && ctx->stored_gama) is unreachable even for inputs carrying a gAMA chunk

evidence: SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA and gAMA-based gamma correction exist since 052bf8d (2018-05-21); the in-tree harness was created 2018-07-27 without the flag
maintainer fix 60fc57f (2019-02-05) 'fuzz: add SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA flag'; the next day e97f3219 'Check for zero image gamma (Credit to OSS-Fuzz)' fixed a bug inside exactly this gated code
M (3a115ee, 2019-01-26) rewrites the gated gamma LUT code itself (8-bit LUT moved to the stack)
rationale_zh: 本次提交改写了 gAMA 伽马校正的查找表代码（8 位 LUT 改为栈上数组，16 位仍走堆分配）。这段代码同时受两个维度门控：一是解码选项 SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA（运行期 flag，configuration），二是输入中必须带 gAMA 块（ctx->stored_gama，input_format：只有特定格式字段的输入才走这条路径）。harness 自 2018-07 创建起就硬编码 spng_decode_image(..., SPNG_FMT_RGBA8, SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS)，从不传 USE_GAMA；种子语料里虽有 18 个带 gAMA 的 PngSuite 文件，查找表构建和逐像素校正行的覆盖仍恒为 0，harness 却照常运行。缺口早于本次 diff（M^1 上同样为 0），属于非本次引入的隐式 mix(configuration+input_format) 退化；维护者在 60fc57f 给 harness 加上 SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA，次日即由 OSS-Fuzz 在这段代码中发现了 gamma 为 0 的 bug（e97f3219）。
rationale_en: This commit rewrites the lookup-table code of gAMA gamma correction (the 8-bit LUT moves to the stack, the 16-bit one stays on the heap). That code is gated by two dimensions: the decode option SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA (a runtime flag, configuration) and a gAMA chunk in the input (ctx->stored_gama, input_format: only inputs carrying that format field take the path). Since its creation in 2018-07 the harness hardcodes spng_decode_image(..., SPNG_FMT_RGBA8, SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS) and never passes USE_GAMA; although the seed corpus contains 18 PngSuite files with a gAMA chunk, the LUT construction and per-pixel correction lines keep zero coverage while the harness runs normally. The gap predates this diff (also zero at M^1): a pre-existing silent mix(configuration+input_format) degradation; the maintainer added SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA to the harness in 60fc57f, and the next day OSS-Fuzz found a zero-gamma bug in exactly this code (e97f3219).
